proposal.criterion: Existing city east head X≈120, front hemisphere and full-width chart margin; a scope proposal, not route modification.

meaning.frontHemisphere: world radial dot castle +Y >0; false means chart-highest-Y surface is the other side.
meaning.chartRect: Authored XZ rectangle only; does not prove local Y is the relevant shell.
meaning.actualArtifactColumn: A vertical ray intersects the existing pre-refinement artifact at this XZ. Not a loaded-body/footing pass.
meaning.nearCoastColumn: Diagnostic only: front side, artifact exists, |railY-terrainY|<30m. Not an install threshold.
